page_title: CHE 0-1 NOT | Chelsea v Nottingham Forest 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' The referee has issued a yellow card to Matt Turner (Nottingham).
90+8' The attendance for today's match is 39820.

90+6' What a sensational goal that would have been! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the left post.
90+5' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Robert Sanchez.
90+4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+2' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez was alert and made a comfortable save.
88' Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
87' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

87' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
86' The game is interrupted. Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
85' Matt Turner (Nottingham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
84' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
81' Half-chance! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) plays a pass into the box, but Robert Sanchez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
81' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
77' Here is a change. Malo Gusto is going off and Mauricio Pochettino gives the last tactical orders to Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Moises Caicedo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ian Maatsen (Chelsea).
77' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
76' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) coming on for Orel Mangala.
72' The game has come to an end for Ola Aina. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham).
72' Steven Cooper is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Serge Aurier (Nottingham) suffers an injury and Gonzalo Montiel comes on.
72' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' The linesman signals that Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chris Wood (Nottingham) replaces Taiwo Awoniyi.
64' A pass by Malo Gusto (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
62' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) replaces Ben Chilwell.
62' Substitution. Conor Gallagher makes his way off the pitch and Cole Palmer (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.
62' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Ryan Yates (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
60' Half-chance! Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) plays a pass into the box, but Robert Sanchez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
59' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
57' Flag up against Ryan Yates (Nottingham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
53' The resulting corner from Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Taiwo Awoniyi shows great vision to find Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
48' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Tim Robinson blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea).
45+5' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Chelsea are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45+4' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner makes a comfortable save.
45+3' Danilo is substituted due to injury. Steven Cooper gives a chance to Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
45+1' Danilo (Nottingham) picks up an injury.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' The corner kick from Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Chelsea earn a corner.
43' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.
42' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ola Aina (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' A pass by Levi Colwill (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
36' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
35' Unlucky! A great strike from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
32' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
31' A big opportunity missed by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the right post.
31' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
30' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tim Robinson saw the whole situation.
28' The Chelsea players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
25' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
25' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
24' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
20' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
18' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
16' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
15' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Nicolas Jackson.
13' Chelsea are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Tim Robinson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
9' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
7' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
6' The referee blows his whistle as Malo Gusto (Chelsea) was too aggressive in his challenge.
3' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
2' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

2' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
2' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
